title: Drawer Material component colors are wrong with System theme selected
scope: Selected by the user on 2026-10-31 ("go for 104", interpreted as UI-014 in context). Implement and verify the Android drawer-theme fix; user clarified the failure is Android-only.
environment: Android-only according to the user. Independently reproduced and verified on QShopper_API_36, Android 16/API 36, Qt 6.12, emulator-5580. User confirmed the fix on an Android emulator and accepted closure; no physical-phone verification is claimed.
reproduction_status: Reproduced on Android with real drawer/theme selection, rendered controls, live OS night-mode changes and drawer reopening. Native regression fails before the fix and passes afterward.
reproduction: Select System in the Theme controls.
Observe incorrect colors on Material components inside the drawer.
actual: Before the fix, System/Dark rendered a light drawer background behind Dark Material controls. Native comparisons identified mismatched composites for the list selector, three action buttons, two color selectors and sensitivity slider.
expected: Drawer surfaces and Material controls use a coherent, readable palette matching the effective system Light/Dark appearance when System is selected, while respecting the chosen primary/accent settings.
impact: Major visual/theme defect, severity explicitly assigned by the user. No data loss or input failure has been reported.
source_notes: Confirmed root cause: Menu.qml selected its background branch using the raw Theme.theme preference. System is a separate enum value and always took the Light branch, even when Android and the Material controls resolved to Dark.

In the native System/Dark case, the drawer padding rendered as RGB (209,209,209), versus (20,20,20) in the matching explicit Dark drawer. Foregrounds and Material control styling already followed Dark, producing the inconsistent composite.
The fix compares root.Material.theme, the actual resolved palette of the drawer. Existing shade choices, explicit Light/Dark appearance, primary/accent settings and geometry remain unchanged.
UI-005 remains resolved. Its existing 47 native checks pass both before and after the drawer fix; the added failures isolate drawer rendering rather than reopening the safe-border issue.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce and record the affected drawer controls and foreground/background color mismatch.
With System selected, drawer surfaces and Material components follow the effective Android appearance coherently, including live system changes and drawer reopening.
Explicit Light/Dark themes and the selected primary/accent settings retain their intended behavior, contrast and state feedback.
Preserve the phone-confirmed UI-005 safe-area, checked-row and native-icon behavior.

Add an automated regression exercising the actual drawer/theme-selection path and rendered result; demonstrate failure before the fix and success afterward. Include native Android System-light/System-dark coverage; the user accepted Android emulator appearance verification for closure on 2026-10-31.
evidence: User backlog report on 2026-10-31: severity major; selecting System Theme from the drawer produces wrong colors on Material components in the drawer.

implementation.change: One binding change in Menu.qml: compare root.Material.theme with Material.Dark instead of comparing the raw Theme.theme selection.
implementation.design: Use the effective palette for color derivation and the raw setting only to represent the selected Light/Dark/System option. Preserve the existing drawer shades, typography, gestures, touch dimensions and palette choices.
implementation.regression: Extend tests/android/test_safeborder.py with --drawer. Native clicks select each theme in the real drawer. Screenshots capture explicit Light/Dark references and compare the System drawer background plus seven unchanged controls: list selector, three action buttons, two color selectors and sensitivity slider. Pixel channel tolerance is two levels. Theme-selection buttons are excluded from pixel matching because their checked positions intentionally differ.
implementation.before: On the original UI-005 APK, 24 of 137 native checks fail: the background and seven control images differ in live System/Dark, initial System/Dark and reopened System/Dark. Controls-present checks, Light matches and all 47 UI-005 controls pass.
implementation.android_after: All 137 native checks pass: 90 drawer comparisons and the existing 47 safe-area/theme/icon/IME/data checks. Coverage includes both actual Android System modes, live changes in both directions while the drawer is open, reopening in every profile and explicit app/OS theme overrides.
implementation.windows_after: Normal Windows configure/build/CTest passes all three suites: 115 UI, 6 keyboard and 61 model records; UI duration 173.66 seconds and total 180.27 seconds. These are regression controls, not evidence of reproducing the Android-only defect.
implementation.isolation: Only emulator-5580 was targeted. Each run uses a unique QSHOPPER_DATA_DIR; native night mode is restored afterward. No phone installation or data deletion was performed.
implementation.apk: Both architectures rebuilt. dist/QShopper-arm64-debug.apk is signed with ../debug.keystore; certificate SHA-256 7c4335c93ec24cb0f92b44ae84ce108180cb299b43ea4e6ef5baafaef7ae029b. APK SHA-256 b2a89ecf59ee723e3e7dd920504db765a0cff19909dd3c07111e80408fbe7782.
implementation.remaining: None for closure. The user accepted Android emulator verification and requested that UI-014 be closed and committed; the earlier physical-phone confirmation step is superseded by that acceptance.
implementation.user_validation: 2026-10-31: user reported "Confirmed to work on with Android Emulator. Close ticked and do commit." Record this as Android emulator confirmation, not physical-phone confirmation.
